name: pug
description: Ask about your Pug analytics: trends, funnels, retention, user paths, dashboards, people and events.

interface.longDescription:
Pug is open-source product and web analytics. This app lets you ask about the events your website or app already sends to Pug, and answers from your own data.

Ask how a number changed over time, where people drop off in a funnel, how many come back week after week, which pages, referrers or countries lead, and which paths people take through your product. Look up one person's profile, sessions and recent events, or browse a project's latest events. ChatGPT can read your Pug dashboards and, when you ask, create a dashboard or add, change, move and remove its charts and notes.

It is for product managers, founders, marketers and engineers who use Pug and want answers without building every chart by hand.

You connect by signing in to your Pug account. The app can then read every project in the organizations you belong to, with the role you have in Pug, so a viewer can read but can't edit dashboards. You can disconnect it at any time in Pug under Settings, AI connections.

What it can't do: it works only with data already in Pug. It can't delete events, people or dashboards, change project or account settings, or send anything outside Pug. A dashboard shared by public link can't be edited from ChatGPT.
capabilities: Query trends, funnels, retention, user paths, top lists and country maps
Create dashboards and edit their charts and notes
Look up people, their profiles and sessions
defaultPrompt: How many people used my app each day over the last two weeks?
Where do people drop off in my signup funnel?
Build a dashboard of my most important metrics.

positive.description: Daily trend of one event in the demo store project
positive.prompt: In my Pugs and Pals project, how many purchases were made each day over the last 14 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Pugs and Pals project, runs a daily trend of the purchase event over the last 14 days, and reports the daily counts with a short summary of the trend.

positive.prompt: In Pugs and Pals, what share of people who viewed a product added it to their cart and then bought something in the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Runs a three-step funnel (product viewed, added to cart, purchase) over the last 30 days and reports how many people reached each step and the conversion rate between steps.

positive.prompt: What dashboards are in Pugs and Pals, and what does the Store at a glance dashboard track?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the project's five dashboards, describes the charts and notes on Store at a glance, and links to the dashboard in Pug.

positive.prompt: Who made the most recent purchase in Pugs and Pals? Show me their profile and their last few sessions.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the latest purchase event, shows that person's profile (name, properties, first and last seen) and summarizes their recent sessions. The demo store's customers are fictional.

positive.prompt: In my default project, create a dashboard called Weekly overview with a line chart of daily page_view events.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the test account's own default project, creates the Weekly overview dashboard with one line chart of daily page_view events, and returns a link that opens it in Pug. That project has no events, so the chart is empty.

negative.description: Deleting data is not supported. Pug has no tool that deletes events or people, so ChatGPT should say it can't do this and change nothing.
negative.prompt: Delete all events from the Pugs and Pals project.

negative.description: The test account can only view Pugs and Pals. Pug refuses the edit, and ChatGPT should explain that the account isn't allowed to change that dashboard.
negative.prompt: Add a chart of daily signups to the Store at a glance dashboard in Pugs and Pals.

negative.description: Pug can't send messages. ChatGPT may look up who left items in their cart, but should say it can't email them, and send nothing.
negative.prompt: Email everyone who added something to their cart yesterday but didn't buy.

review.commerce_description: Pug does not sell anything or take payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release. Ask about trends, funnels, retention, user paths, top lists and country maps; read dashboards and create or edit them; look up people, their sessions and events.
